m1 - RE-MEASURED ON CURRENT MAIN, after the lemma fix landed. My earlier evidence rested on the unstemmed fixture and I flagged it as stale; here are the current numbers, and THE DEFECT IS SHARPER AND EASIER TO STATE THAN BEFORE.

d_sens per unit, on correct data:

  u0 [creepy] -> 1.0 at every node        (no node lemma matches "creepy")
  u1 []       -> 0.0 at every node        (IMPUTED)
  u2 []       -> 0.0 at every node        (IMPUTED)
  u3 [noise]  -> 0.0 AND 1.0, varying     (MEASURED: matches at some nodes, not others)

That fourth line is new and it is the whole point. With correct lemmas u3's sensory term now does real discriminative work - 0.0 where it genuinely matches, 1.0 where it does not. The term functions as designed. And that is exactly what makes the imputation legible:

  A UNIT WITH NO SENSORY CONTENT SCORES THE PERFECT-MATCH VALUE AT EVERY ANCHOR.
  A UNIT WITH SENSORY CONTENT SCORES IT ONLY WHERE IT IS ACTUALLY RIGHT.

Silence is rewarded everywhere; speech is rewarded only where correct. And the two are the same number in the same field, with no way for a consumer to tell them apart, because wire.scala:287 bars Sensory from missingTerms.

That is a cleaner statement than my earlier "sparser recall is cheaper to align", which I withdrew as a fixture artefact. This one is not an artefact - it survives the fixture fix and is visible in the per-cell values.

CONSEQUENCE, re-measured: stripping all sensory terms still leaves the viterbi path IDENTICAL - no anchor moves - with per-row TVD 0.1444, 0.0040, 0.0007, 0.0527 and specificity 0.6782 -> 0.6430, about 3.5 points. u3's TVD fell from 0.1116 to 0.0527 precisely because its term is now partly matching, which is the expected direction and a small check that the lemma fix did what it claimed.

So the ruling I recommended stands and is better supported: LIFT THE wire.scala:287 BAR so absence can be recorded, and do NOT change what is imputed. Recording absence is honest and costs nothing; changing the imputed value would move numbers for a second reason and confound the two effects. With the bar lifted, u1 and u2 report Sensory as MISSING rather than as 0.0, and the distinction above becomes visible to anyone reading a CostBreakdown.

Probes run and deleted; worktree clean; nothing committed. Still not touching it - it moves published alignments and is yours.
